    parser.add_argument('--format', choices=['text', 'json'], default='text')

"""Command-line interface for sample-count."""

import argparse
import io
import sys
from collections.abc import Sequence

from sample_count import count_lines


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="sample-count",
        description="Count nonempty UTF-8 lines using Python str.strip().",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "path",
        nargs="?",
        default="-",
        help="UTF-8 input file; omit or use '-' to read standard input",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    try:
        if args.path == "-":
            # Decode bytes explicitly, independent of the terminal's encoding.
            # newline=None recognizes LF, CRLF, and CR.
            with io.TextIOWrapper(
                sys.stdin.buffer,
                encoding="utf-8",
                errors="strict",
                newline=None,
            ) as stream:
                count = count_lines(stream)
        else:
            with open(
                args.path,
                encoding="utf-8",
                errors="strict",
                newline=None,
            ) as stream:
                count = count_lines(stream)

        print(count)
    except (OSError, UnicodeError) as exc:
        print(f"sample-count: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    return 0

name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  checks:
    name: ${{ matrix.os }} / Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        python-version: ["3.11", "3.14"]

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install project and development dependencies
        run: python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Lint with ruff
        run: python -m ruff check .

      - name: Check formatting with ruff
        run: python -m ruff format --check .

      - name: Test with pytest
        run: python -m pytest

import pytest

from sample_count.core import count_nonempty


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("lines", "expected"),
    [
        ([], 0),
        ([""], 0),
        (["\n", "\r\n", "\r"], 0),
        ([" ", "\t", " \t\n", "\t\r\n"], 0),
        (["\u2003", "\u00a0", " \t\u2003\u00a0\n"], 0),
        (["hello\n", "world\n"], 2),
        ([" \thello\u2003\n", "\u00a0world \n"], 2),
        (["first\n", "", " \t\n", "\u2003\u00a0\n", "last"], 2),
        (["final line without newline"], 1),
    ],
    ids=[
        "empty-input",
        "empty-string",
        "newline-only",
        "ascii-whitespace-only",
        "unicode-whitespace-only",
        "nonempty-lines",
        "whitespace-around-content",
        "mixed-lines",
        "final-line-without-newline",
    ],
)
def test_count_nonempty(lines: list[str], expected: int) -> None:
    assert count_nonempty(lines) == expected


def test_accepts_single_pass_iterable() -> None:
    lines = (line for line in ["first\n", "\u2003\n", "last"])
    assert count_nonempty(lines) == 2


@pytest.mark.parametrize("newline", [b"\n", b"\r\n", b"\r"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("trailing_newline", [False, True])
def test_file_reading_with_universal_newlines(
    tmp_path, newline: bytes, trailing_newline: bool
) -> None:
    lines = ["first", "", " \t", "\u2003", "\u00a0", "last"]
    data = newline.join(line.encode("utf-8") for line in lines)
    if trailing_newline:
        data += newline

    path = tmp_path / "input.txt"
    path.write_bytes(data)

    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8", newline=None) as stream:
        assert count_nonempty(stream) == 2


def test_file_reading_with_mixed_universal_newlines(tmp_path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "mixed.txt"
    path.write_bytes("first\r\n \t\r\u2003\n\u00a0\r\nlast".encode("utf-8"))

    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8", newline=None) as stream:
        assert count_nonempty(stream) == 2

src/sample_count/cli.py.text:
"""Command-line interface and streaming line counter."""

import argparse
import io
import sys
from collections.abc import Iterable, Sequence
from contextlib import ExitStack


def count_lines(lines: Iterable[str]) -> int:
    """Count lines whose stripped content is nonempty."""
    return sum(bool(line.strip()) for line in lines)


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="sample-count",
        description="Count nonempty UTF-8 lines from a file or standard input.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "path",
        nargs="?",
        default="-",
        help="UTF-8 input file; omit or use - for standard input",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    try:
        with ExitStack() as stack:
            if args.path == "-":
                # Explicit decoding and universal newlines on every platform.
                stream = io.TextIOWrapper(
                    sys.stdin.buffer,
                    encoding="utf-8",
                    errors="strict",
                    newline=None,
                )
                # Leave the underlying standard-input buffer open.
                stack.callback(stream.detach)
            else:
                stream = stack.enter_context(
                    open(
                        args.path,
                        encoding="utf-8",
                        errors="strict",
                        newline=None,
                    )
                )

            total = count_lines(stream)

        print(total)
    except (OSError, UnicodeError) as exc:
        print(f"{parser.prog}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    return 0

import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest


def run_cli(
    *args: str,
    input_bytes: bytes | None = None,
) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:
    return subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "sample_count", *args],
        input=input_bytes,
        capture_output=True,
        check=False,
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("ending", ["\n", "\r\n", "\r"])
def test_counts_file_with_supported_line_endings(
    tmp_path: Path,
    ending: str,
) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "input.txt"
    content = ending.join(
        ["first", "", " \t", "\u2003", "\u00a0", " second ", "last"]
    )
    path.write_bytes(content.encode("utf-8"))

    result = run_cli(str(path))

    assert result.returncode == 0
    assert result.stdout == b"3\n" or result.stdout == b"3\r\n"
    assert result.stderr == b""


def test_rejects_invalid_utf8(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "invalid.txt"
    path.write_bytes(b"valid\n\xff\n")

    result = run_cli(str(path))

    assert result.returncode == 1
    assert result.stdout == b""
    assert result.stderr.startswith(b"sample-count:")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("args", [(), ("-",)])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("content", "expected"),
    [
        ("", 0),
        (" \t\r\n\u2003\r\u00a0\n", 0),
        (" \t\r\n\u2003\r\u00a0\nalpha\r\nbeta\rgamma", 3),
    ],
)
def test_stdin_defaults_and_whitespace_edges(
    args: tuple[str, ...],
    content: str,
    expected: int,
) -> None:
    result = run_cli(*args, input_bytes=content.encode("utf-8"))

    assert result.returncode == 0
    assert result.stdout.decode("ascii").splitlines() == [str(expected)]
    assert result.stderr == b""
